candidateOccurrences.sourceText: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of the LORD. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As the LORD has said to your servants, so will we do.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As the LORD has said to your servants, so will we do.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。
